items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Raymond would say to me I need a chart on 'My Mama Done Told Me' for Dorothy... So I'd get in my hotel room and write the chart for him and Dorothy would sing it.

ctx.x: Yeah, those are his. I joined his quintet and then it became a big band and we went on tour. He had a manager named Harvey Bacall who really took advantage of me. One night he found out that I could write--they were having me write for them-- as we toured around, we'd get into town and Raymond would say to me I need a chart on "My Mama Done Told Me" for Dorothy and I want to do it in the show this afternoon. He'd tell me that in the morning. So I'd get in my hotel room and write the chart for him and Dorothy…
